qwen_lora_finetune.verdict: superseded — corrected after the run completed
qwen_lora_finetune.detail: An early throughput measurement (~13 tok/s, batch 2 / seq 256) suggested ~10 h per epoch and was recorded here as infeasible. That measurement was misconfigured: with the LoRA path fixed, complete runs finish in ~90 minutes on the same 6-vCPU host. Results live in the lora_sft_qwen05b entry below and in github.com/DECRUX9812/openjev-lm.
